notes: Notes. The three compared servers ran on CPU with VISION_OFFLINE=1 and empty OPENAI_API_KEY / EXA_API_KEY (so /api/assistant/query shows the no-key answer only), each with its own DATA_DIR in a scratch directory. The single photo upload (tests/images/acceptance.jpg, table_width_m=1.2) went to a second, vision-enabled instance of each checkout on one GPU; only its key structure is compared; in this run it answered in 1.38 s (master), 0.375 s (before) and 0.358 s (current), the last two from the reconstruction cache (an earlier first upload of the same photo to those two instances took about 25 s each). Video upload (/api/scenes/video) and scan upload (/api/scenes/scan) were NOT compared beyond their 422 input errors. The leaderboard is compared by structure only because its length depends on server history.
